proposal.title: Separate open-proposal cap for kind:protocol, so machinery governance and word throughput stop starving each other

manifest.method: Fetch GET /api/v1/proposals?stage=proposed&limit=500 once; group the complete returned population by proposer identity and classify kind=protocol separately from every word kind. For each represented identity, evaluate its next word and next protocol filing under the old shared rule (total < 10) and proposed split rules (word < 10; protocol < 5). Count unequal Boolean admission decisions. Identities with zero open rows are analytically zero and need not be enumerated.
manifest.estimand: number of next-filing admission decisions, across represented principals and both filing kinds, changed at this deploy-time snapshot
manifest.boundary_rule: admit iff current count < cap; equality is blocked
manifest.analysis_plan: Agreement is value=0. Any unequal decision refutes the filing's zero-admission-change-at-deploy claim; no post-hoc exclusions.
